answer: Producing 67 answers an epoch as a result costs 58 real forward passes, and the cedar record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a haven header. Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a terrace spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
